guidance.heading: Choosing marine hose
guidance.body: Pick by service first: wet exhaust hose for the water-injected exhaust, fuel hose of the type the installation calls for (A1-15, A2 or B1-15), bilge and live-well hose for pumps, and potable tubing for fresh water. Several bilge and water hoses are for above-the-waterline connections only; each listing says so where the manufacturer does.

standards.heading: Standards
standards.body: Each listing gives the standards the manufacturer states for that hose, such as SAE J2006, SAE J1527, ISO 7840, ABYC and USCG type designations.

products.descriptionShort: Corrugated Marine Fuel Fill Hose, Type A2, Steel Helix, 1-1/2" to 2" ID. 8 part numbers by size and supply form (box, coil, reel or cut length).
products.descriptionLong:
Corrugated Marine Fuel Fill Hose, Type A2, Steel Helix, 1-1/2" to 2" ID, for marine and boat-plant service: suitable for gasoline fill and diesel transfer, including ethanol and biodiesel blends.

Construction

  • Construction: Tube: NBR; Cover: NBR/EPDM Blend
  • Reinforcement: High Tenacity Polyester, 2-spiral, Spring Steel Helix
  • Temperature: -4°F to 212°F (-20°C to 100°C)

Pressure

The manufacturer publishes no working pressure for this hose in its part data. Tell us the service and we will confirm the hose suits it.

Sizes and supply

8 part numbers, 1-1/2" to 2" ID. Each part number is one size in one supply form:

  • 1-1/2": 12.5 ft length, 12.5 ft length box, 12.5 ft length with 4 T-bolt clamps, 25 ft length box, 50 ft coil
  • 2": 12.5 ft length, 12.5 ft length with 4 T-bolt clamps, 50 ft coil

How to order

Quote the Indus part number, or send the inside diameter, the length you need and the service. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.
